responseMessageContents.text:
The user is asking whether the admin login URL changes after the Firebase migration. Let me check the current backend setup to answer this accurately.

The admin panel is served from the Cloudflare Workers backend. The URL was `https://kidhero-health-sync-backend.rork.app/admin`. The Firebase migration so far has only touched the Android app (adding Firebase SDK, google-services.json, Gradle config) — it hasn't changed the backend yet. So the admin URL should remain the same.

Let me verify by checking the current backend URL config.

No, the admin login URL does not change.

The Firebase setup so far only affects the **Android app** (Gradle plugins, `google-services.json`, Firebase SDK dependencies). The admin panel is still served by your Cloudflare Workers backend, so the URL stays the same:

**Admin portal:** https://kidhero-health-sync-backend.rork.app/admin

Firebase Authentication will replace the OTP flow on the **app side** (doctor login on the phone), but the admin panel is a separate web page served by Cloudflare and won't move unless we explicitly migrate it to Firebase Hosting later.

Would you like me to proceed with the Firebase Auth + Firestore backend migration now?
